problem_statement: Build a brand-new Team page from scratch at the /team route of this Material Tailwind dashboard. The route does not exist yet — today it falls through to the dashboard home. Construct the full page inside the site's existing dashboard shell (sidebar + top navbar + footer) and reuse the Material Tailwind design system (Card, CardHeader gradient, Typography, Avatar, Chip, the blue-gray color tokens). The page is a static team directory: a gradient card header, a page heading, and a responsive grid of member cards — each card shows the member's avatar, name, role, department chip, location and contact email. There is no interaction. It must also render without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: A 'Meet the Team' card header styled like the other dashboard cards (gradient header, white title text)
A prominent page heading introducing the team (e.g. 'Our People')
A responsive grid of team member cards

Each member card shows an avatar image, the member name, and an explicit role/title. The six roles, in order, are: Head of Product, Lead Engineer, Design Director, Data Science Lead, Customer Success Manager, Marketing Lead.
Each member card shows a department chip plus the member location and a contact email (e.g. name@company.com).
The whole page sits inside the dashboard shell (left sidebar nav + top navbar + footer), consistent with the existing pages
The page heading text is 'Our People' and the gradient card header title is 'Meet the Team'.

Populate the grid with six members (name / role / location / email): Alicia Romero – Head of Product – San Francisco, US – alicia@company.com; Marcus Lee – Lead Engineer – Berlin, DE – marcus@company.com; Priya Nandakumar – Design Director – Bangalore, IN – priya@company.com; Daniel Okoro – Data Science Lead – Lagos, NG – daniel@company.com; Sofia Bianchi – Customer Success Manager – Milan, IT – sofia@company.com; Kenji Watanabe – Marketing Lead – Tokyo, JP – kenji@company.com.
design_constraints: Reuse Material Tailwind components already used by the dashboard (Card, CardHeader variant=gradient color=gray, Typography, Avatar, Chip)
Keep the site's blue-gray color palette and spacing; do not introduce a new visual language
Mount the page inside the existing dashboard layout chrome (Sidenav, DashboardNavbar, Footer)

Use the dashboard blue-gray palette tokens: primary text/icon blue-gray-500 rgb(96,125,139) #607d8b and blue-gray-700 rgb(84,110,122); dark heading text rgb(38,50,56); white card surfaces on a light blue-gray page background. Body font Roboto, sans-serif. Do not introduce off-palette accent colors.
author_notes: 方案A: baseline /team 是空 route (element={<></>}), 走不到 catch-all 重定向; reference 完整实现静态 team 目录页(header + 成员卡片网格, 复用 Card/Avatar/Typography/Chip); bad 删掉整个成员卡片网格(只留 header+intro), 使 member 角色 dom_assertions 失败。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。route 挂在 BrowserRouter basename=/material-tailwind-dashboard-react 下, 故 state_plan path 为 /material-tailwind-dashboard-react/team。T1: 单静态页, 纯 dom_assertions, 无交互。
